name: pool-maintenance
//: The budget domain of the pool maintenance onevcs.toml declares: its budgets.yaml and the measurement that exists only for it. That measurement builds the workspace twice and times a real prune, so it is `budgets-host` alone, which no per-change path reaches: neither this project's `check` nor `just check`, `just test` or `just gate` names it, and the release pull request runs it by name after its gate (`just pool-maintenance-budget`, .github/workflows/ci.yml). It depends on no other project; the only edge is the one `workspace` has to every project.

bootstrap.//: The pinned pruner is installed by the justfile's own `bootstrap` recipe, from the one pin the `pool-maintenance` recipe runs, rather than by a target here.

format.//: Uncached: it rewrites the tree in place.

lint.//: Parses the measurement without running it, which is all a per-change path may do with it.

typecheck.//: Declared and empty, because `nx affected` fans out by target name; a shell script has no type-checking step.

test.//: Declared and empty: what this project holds is a measurement, and running it is `budgets-host`, which builds the workspace twice and so stays off every per-change path.

coverage.//: Declared and empty: there is no line coverage for a shell script.

options.command: bun run onebudgetspec check pool-maintenance/budgets.yaml --label host

budgets-host.//: Wall-clock time on the host that runs it, so never cached (the target default). Not a dependency of `check` and not a target `just test` selects.
